vorhaben.laeuft_weiter: No rush: your project simply keeps going — nothing expires.
vorhaben.naechste_woche: A new project is waiting for you next week.

drachenfest.finale: The kite is dancing! Gooby takes a solemn bow before the wind.

s0.text: Harvest 2 beds — wind berries for the festival.
s0.zwischen: Gooby holds a finger into the breeze: “Perfect kite weather! Nothing takes off without wind berries.”

s1.text: Practise airy stunts: play 3 minigame rounds.
s1.zwischen: “The kite is already practising loops. I’m practising… watching.”

s2.zwischen: “A kite festival without a picnic is just… wind.”

picknick.finale: Blanket out, sunshine on — that was the best picnic of the week!

s0.text: Water 4 times — make those beds sparkle.
s0.zwischen: “First watering, then feasting. Says Gooby. Repeatedly.”

s1.text: Harvest 2 beds for the picnic basket.
s1.zwischen: “The basket is still as empty as Gooby’s tummy.”

s2.zwischen: “One taste, one re-taste. Purely for quality control!”

funkelputz.finale: Gooby sparkles so much the mirror is wearing sunglasses.

s0.text: Wash Gooby 2 times in the bathtub.
s0.zwischen: “Operation Foam Crown in progress. Do not disturb.”

s1.zwischen: “Squeaky clean on top — now the smile sparkles too.”

muenzmission.finale: Mission complete! Gooby tosses a coin and wishes for… another week like this.

s0.zwischen: “Pocket-money time! Gooby counts every coin twice. Out of joy.”

s1.text: Treat yourself — spend a few coins.
s1.zwischen: “Saving is great. Treating yourself is greater.”

arcadetour.finale: Tour finished! Gooby waves at the crowd. The crowd is the fridge.

s0.zwischen: “Tour rule number one: variety beats high scores. Almost.”

s1.zwischen: “The machines are already whispering your name.”

s2.zwischen: “Champions need provisions. Says the coach. The coach is Gooby.”

beetballett.finale: Applause, applause! The veggies take a bow. So does Gooby.

s0.zwischen: “Act one: the seedlings take the stage!”

s1.zwischen: “Act two: rain dance! Gooby conducts with the watering can.”

s2.zwischen: “The curtain is about to fall — er, the harvest!”

wellness.finale: Deeply relaxed and utterly happy — champion-level wellness complete!

s0.text: Make Gooby squeal with joy — tickling helps.
s0.zwischen: “Wellness plan, item one: laugh until the belly wobbles.”

s1.text: A bath for Gooby — one good lather, please.
s1.zwischen: “Item two: bubbles up to behind the ears.”

s2.zwischen: “Item three: freshness for the champion smile.”

s3.zwischen: “And finally: room service! Gooby has already taken a seat.”
